caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet set against a plain, light beige background. The cabinet is rectangular in shape, extending vertically, and is topped with a corniced molding. The upper portion of the cabinet features an open shelving area with three shelves, each shelf having a slight curvature and all enclosed by a frame with a softly arched top. The shelves and interior are rendered in brown hues with visible wood grain texture. Below the shelving unit, there is a single-panel door with three rectangular recessed panels; the wood grain continues through the door, and the door is equipped with a keyhole and a small angled handle on the right side. The door is mounted with two visible hinges on the left. The cabinet is depicted in shades of brown, with corners and panel edges accentuated by darker lines to suggest depth and wood joints. There are no visible contents on the shelves or within the cabinet. The entire drawing is centered on the page with ample blank space surrounding it.
title: Cupboard
